description: Incoming endpoint path parsing. An incoming endpoint declares either an exact 'path' or a 'pathPrefix', but exactly one of the two. Declaring both is rejected with a path-conflict error; declaring neither is rejected with a path-missing error. A field present with an explicit null value is treated as absent, so an endpoint with a real path and a null prefix is valid and matches by exact path, while a null path and a real prefix is valid and matches by prefix. On success the output reports the resolved path value and the matching type.
